_comment: Android permissions that scam apps commonly abuse. Keys are the short permission names; values describe the risk in plain English.
READ_SMS: Read all SMS messages, including bank OTPs
RECEIVE_SMS: Receive SMS messages the moment they arrive
SEND_SMS: Send SMS messages from the phone
BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE: See the screen and tap buttons on the user's behalf
SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW: Draw fake screens on top of other apps
QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES: List every app installed on the phone
